targets.query:
topMethods =
  from(bucket: "${custom_bucket_name}")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._measurement == "method_timing" and
      r._field == "duration_ns" and
      contains(value: r.class, set: ${custom_class:json})
    )
    |> group(columns: ["class", "name", "param_types"])
    |> sum(column: "_value")
    |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
    |> limit(n: 20)
    |> keep(columns: ["class", "name", "param_types"])

data =
  from(bucket: "${custom_bucket_name}")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._measurement == "method_timing" and
      r._field == "duration_ns"
    )

joined =
  join(
    tables: {d: data, t: topMethods},
    on: ["class", "name", "param_types"]
  )
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "result", "table"])

joined
  |> group(columns: ["class", "name", "param_types"])
  |> aggregateWindow(
      every: ${custom_interval},
      fn: sum,
      column: "_value",
      createEmpty: false
    )

targets.query:
import "join"

// 0) Исходный поток raw
raw =
  from(bucket: "${custom_bucket_name}")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
        r._measurement == "method_timing" and
        r._field       == "duration_ns"
      )

// 1) Базовая статистика: count, sum_ns, max_ns
stats =
  raw
    |> group(columns: ["class", "name", "param_types"])
    |> reduce(
        fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
            class:  r.class,
            name:   r.name,
            param_types: r.param_types,
            count:  accumulator.count + 1,
            sum_ns: accumulator.sum_ns + float(v: r._value),
            max_ns: if float(v: r._value) > accumulator.max_ns
                      then float(v: r._value)
                      else accumulator.max_ns
        }),
        identity: {
            class:  "",
            name:   "",
            param_types: "",
            count:  0,
            sum_ns: 0.0,
            max_ns: 0.0
        }
    )

// 2) Ветки для квантилей
p50 =
  raw
    |> group(columns: ["class", "name", "param_types"])
    |> quantile(q: 0.50, column: "_value", method: "estimate_tdigest")
    |> rename(columns: {_value: "p50_ns"})

p90 =
  raw
    |> group(columns: ["class", "name", "param_types"])
    |> quantile(q: 0.9, column: "_value", method: "estimate_tdigest")
    |> rename(columns: {_value: "p90_ns"})

p95 =
  raw
    |> group(columns: ["class", "name", "param_types"])
    |> quantile(q: 0.95, column: "_value", method: "estimate_tdigest")
    |> rename(columns: {_value: "p95_ns"})

p99 =
  raw
    |> group(columns: ["class", "name", "param_types"])
    |> quantile(q: 0.99, column: "_value", method: "estimate_tdigest")
    |> rename(columns: {_value: "p99_ns"})

// 3) Поочерёдные inner-join’ы, без использования "_" в качестве left
joined =
  stats
    |> join.inner(
         right: p50,
         on:    (l, r) => l.class == r.class and l.name == r.name and l.param_types == r.param_types, 
         as:    (l, r) => ({ l with p50_ns: r.p50_ns })
       )
    |> join.inner(
         right: p90,
         on:    (l, r) => l.class == r.class and l.name == r.name and l.param_types == r.param_types, 
         as:    (l, r) => ({ l with p90_ns: r.p90_ns })
       )
    |> join.inner(
         right: p95,
         on:    (l, r) => l.class == r.class and l.name == r.name and l.param_types == r.param_types, 
         as:    (l, r) => ({ l with p95_ns: r.p95_ns })
       )
    |> join.inner(
         right: p99,
         on:    (l, r) => l.class == r.class and l.name == r.name and l.param_types == r.param_types, 
         as:    (l, r) => ({ l with p99_ns: r.p99_ns })
       )

// 4) Финальный map + keep + sort + limit
joined
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
       class_method: string(v: r.class) + "." + string(v: r.name) + string(v: r.param_types),
       avg_ns:       if r.count == 0 then 0.0 else r.sum_ns / float(v: r.count),
       sum_ns:       r.sum_ns,
       count:       r.count,
       max_ns:       r.max_ns,
       p50_ns:       r.p50_ns,
       p90_ns:       r.p90_ns,
       p95_ns:       r.p95_ns,
       p99_ns:       r.p99_ns
     }))
  |> keep(columns: ["class_method", "count", "avg_ns","sum_ns","max_ns","p50_ns", "p90_ns","p95_ns","p99_ns"])
  |> sort(columns: ["sum_ns"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 100)
